Usage Meter for Grok is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with xAI. It does not run a server and it does not see your password. Sign-in opens the official xAI page inside this app. The app reads the usage text that page already shows and saves those numbers on this phone so you can view them offline. Sign out deletes the saved numbers and the in-app sign-in cookies. Billing pages open on grok.com under your own account.
